title: Permit keys (connector protocol 2.0, draft)
description: The Brain's answer to GET /secured/connector/v2/permit-keys, over Link's mTLS channel only: the public keys Link verifies permits with. Link pins them; it accepts a new key only from this route, and never from the Platform or a job. A key past not_after verifies nothing. Closed.

public_key.description: The 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding.
